components.content:
# Rainfall on Roofs and Gutter Slopes

Draining of roof areas and recommended gutter slopes when draining roof areas.

## Recommended Gutter Slopes for Draining Roof Areas

The following table provides recommended gutter capacities based on gutter diameter and slope at a rainfall intensity of **100 mm per hour (4 inches per hour)**.

| Gutter Diameter | Gutter Slope | 0.5% | 1% | 2% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **mm (inches)** | | **m² (ft²)** | **m² (ft²)** | **m² (ft²)** |
| 80 (3") | - | 16 (170) | 22 (240) | 32 (350) |
| 100 (4") | - | 33 (360) | 47 (510) | 67 (720) |
| 125 (5") | - | 58 (625) | 82 (880) | 116 (1250) |
| 150 (6") | - | 89 (960) | 126 (1360) | 178 (1920) |

## Slope Definitions

- **0.5%** = 0.5 cm per 100 cm run = 0.0625 inch per 1 ft run
- **1%** = 1 cm per 100 cm run = 0.125 inch per 1 ft run
- **2%** = 2 cm per 100 cm run = 0.250 inch per 1 ft run

## Gutter Size vs. Downspout Size

- 100 mm (4") gutter → 75 mm (3") downspout
- 125 mm (5") gutter → 100 mm (4") downspout
- 150 mm (6") gutter → 100 mm (4") downspout

**Note:** Anticipated rainfall intensity should always be checked with local authorities. As a reference, the maximum rainfall intensity used in the UK is normally 75 mm per hour.

outputs.label: Drainage Capacity at Selected Slope
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '0.5', IF(inputs.roof_area <= 16, 16, IF(inputs.roof_area <= 33, 33, IF(inputs.roof_area <= 58, 58, 89))), IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '1', IF(inputs.roof_area <= 22, 22, IF(inputs.roof_area <= 47, 47, IF(inputs.roof_area <= 82, 82, 126))), IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '2', IF(inputs.roof_area <= 32, 32, IF(inputs.roof_area <= 67, 67, IF(inputs.roof_area <= 116, 116, 178))), 0)))

outputs.label: Roof Area Suitability
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.roof_area <= IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '0.5', 89, IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '1', 126, 178)), 'YES - Suitable for 150mm gutter', IF(inputs.roof_area <= IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '0.5', 58, IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '1', 82, 116)), 'YES - Suitable for 125mm gutter', IF(inputs.roof_area <= IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '0.5', 33, IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '1', 47, 67)), 'YES - Suitable for 100mm gutter', IF(inputs.roof_area <= IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '0.5', 16, IF(inputs.gutter_slope == '1', 22, 32)), 'YES - Suitable for 80mm gutter', 'NO - Area exceeds all gutter capacities'))))
